description: Places where the golden outputs (OpenSAS container, see manifest.json) are known to differ from SAS 9.4 semantics. Parity controls accept the SAS-semantics value on exactly these cells and report the exception; everything else is compared as-is.

deviations.sas_expression: case when calculated NPL_BALANCE > 0 then sum(l.ALLOWANCE_AMT) / calculated NPL_BALANCE * 100 else 0 end
deviations.golden_behaviour: 0 on every row, including CC (NPL_BALANCE 5195.86) and MTG (NPL_BALANCE 1176940.10) for 202401.
deviations.expected_sas_behaviour: TOTAL_ALLOWANCE / NPL_BALANCE * 100 when NPL_BALANCE > 0 (CALCULATED may reference a summary-function alias in the same SELECT).
deviations.migration_decision: Model implements the SAS 9.4 formula. Golden parity accepts the model value on rows where the golden is 0 and NPL_BALANCE > 0 only if it equals TOTAL_ALLOWANCE / NPL_BALANCE * 100 computed from the golden's own figures.
deviations.how_to_close: Re-run the estate on SAS 9.4 (or an OpenSAS build that folds CALCULATED aggregate aliases in CASE) and re-import the golden; the exception then never triggers.
